missing_methods.intent: Verify user profile name is visible in dashboard header
missing_methods.detailed_requirements: Wait for the user profile name element in the dashboard header to be visible. Locate the profile name element using appropriate locator strategy (CSS, XPath, or ID). Assert that the element is displayed on the page. Return True if visible, raise assertion error if not visible.

missing_methods.intent: Assert user profile name is visible
missing_methods.detailed_requirements: Wait for the user profile name element in the dashboard header to be visible. Locate the profile name element using appropriate locator strategy. Perform a hard assertion that the element is displayed. Raise AssertionError with descriptive message if the profile name is not visible. This method should fail the test immediately if the assertion fails.
